cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The table can float while we pack. Put a mat under that wet cup. I thought I'd cured you of putting drinks straight on the polish.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at the ceiling. I'll pull the table down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wait! The cup will slide and scratch it. Get the stepladder; you still rush the delicate bits, after all those moves with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll climb up, but my boots are muddy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boots off! Socks too if they're damp. We are not adding footprints to that water ring.
